title: [DocDB] Fix compilation for gcc9 release
body:
Jira Link: [DB-485](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-485)
### Description

Even after doing compilation fixes for gcc9 fastdebug (#11710), it fails for release:

    /-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | COMPILATION FAILED
    |-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    In file included from src/postgres/src/include/postgres.h:47,
                     from src/postgres/src/backend/tcop/postgres.c:20:
    src/postgres/src/backend/tcop/postgres.c: In function ‘yb_exec_query_wrapper’:
    src/postgres/src/include/utils/elog.h:301:15: error: ‘save_exception_stack’ is used uninitialized in this function [-Werror=uninitialized]
      301 |   sigjmp_buf *save_exception_stack = PG_exception_stack; \
          |               ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
    src/postgres/src/include/utils/elog.h:301:15: note: ‘save_exception_stack’ was declared here
      301 |   sigjmp_buf *save_exception_stack = PG_exception_stack; \
          |               ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
    src/postgres/src/backend/tcop/postgres.c:4526:3: note: in expansion of macro ‘PG_TRY’
     4526 |   PG_TRY();
          |   ^~~~~~
    src/postgres/src/include/utils/elog.h:302:25: error: ‘save_context_stack’ is used uninitialized in this function [-Werror=uninitialized]
      302 |   ErrorContextCallback *save_context_stack = error_context_stack; \
          |                         ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
    src/postgres/src/include/utils/elog.h:302:25: note: ‘save_context_stack’ was declared here
      302 |   ErrorContextCallback *save_context_stack = error_context_stack; \
          |                         ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
    src/postgres/src/backend/tcop/postgres.c:4526:3: note: in expansion of macro ‘PG_TRY’
     4526 |   PG_TRY();
          |   ^~~~~~
    cc1: all warnings being treated as errors
    Input files:
      build/release-gcc9-dynamic-ninja/postgres_build/src/backend/tcop/postgres.c
    Output file (from -o): postgres.o
    \-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Fix this.
